extracted.intended_audience: CIA managers, Special Security Center staff, and US Intelligence Community officials responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 and agency management improvements
extracted.subtask_description: Agency-level implementation guidance for OMB Circular A-44 focused on management effectiveness and cost-reduction goals as contributed by the CIA Special Security Center to the Agency's management improvement program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide security policy, direction and guidance to the US Intelligence Community on three compartmented security control systems established to protect sensitive intelligence sources and 25X1 methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attachment to SSC-0526-70 Section I states the Special Security Center's contribution toward the Agency's management improvement program as directed by the Executive Director-Comptroller. Also: "Provide guidance to the I an controls employed to protect highly sensitive US intelligence." (OCR artifacts preserved from source.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless there is a policy change at the highest level affecting the classification of compartmented programs, it is not expected that there will be any earnings measurably in dollars or manpower for FY 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section II indicates limited or no expected cost savings for FY 1971 in the absence of high-level policy changes affecting program classification; positions cost-reduction as a stated goal but tempering expectations given classification constraints.
